notes.title: 🧠 'How Old is James?' Joins the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2025
notes.content:
[h3]🧩 About the Game[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2755820/How_Old_is_James/]How Old is James?[/url] is an introspective narrative puzzler set in the year 2095. Players navigate a futuristic operating system to explore layers of consciousness. EGO, ID, and SUPEREGO each have their own unique mechanics. Assemble memories and solve intricate puzzles. the game delves into themes of identity and humanity.

[h3]🎮 Event Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Demo[/b]: We are excited to bring our demo to an audience we think will really appreciate what the game is.
[*] [b]The Official Showcase Livestream[/b]: To celebrate the first few days of the showcase, the organisers will be hosting a livestream from [i][u][b]May 29th - June 1st between 12:00 - 19:00 EDT[/b][/u][/i]. This livestream will take place on the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase Steam homepage. Find us there!
[*] [b]Community Engagement[/b]: For the livestream event, there will be a lineup of streamers and content creators. They will be playing through many of the games featured in the showcase. We as the devs will be sure to swing by and say hello.
[/list]

[h3]🔗 Join the Showcase[/h3]
Discover How Old is James? and other thought-provoking titles during the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase.
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]Visit the Steam Fest Page[/url].
